source_scope: T3PA only, 2012-2023 development; 2024 and 2025 confirmation; 2026 excluded
covariate_authorization: Parent /root message received after addendum: retain historical auction volume/total bid volume/cover ratio/bidder counts. Sum auction/bid volumes; cover=sum bids/sum auction volume; bidder counts use auction-volume-weighted averages for multiple same-day auctions, never a unique-person total. Preserve missing markers; no zero fill.

daily_rules.auction_volume: sum(final reported auction volume of included components)
daily_rules.total_bid_volume: sum(Total Amount of Bids); missing if any included component missing
daily_rules.cover_ratio: sum(total_bid_volume)/sum(auction_volume), not an average of rounded source cover ratios
daily_rules.bidder_count: sum(Total Number of Bidders*auction_volume)/sum(auction_volume); missing if any component missing
daily_rules.successful_bidder_count: same weighted average of Number of Successful Bidders; missing if any component missing
daily_rules.auction_names: unique literal official Auction Name labels, sorted; all source auctions are EEX. These are auction-program labels, not separate exchange venues.
daily_rules.rounding: source finite numbers via Decimal(str(cell)); calculations at 50 decimal digits; write plain decimal strings without discretionary price rounding
daily_rules.duplicates: date/time/auction_name/contract; exact duplicate result fields dedup, conflicting identity fails
daily_rules.no_future_features: No future calendar, volume, bids, clearing results or gaps constructed; each covariate is the result known after its own auction.

read_timeline: Schema audit occurred after pre-price source scope. Inclusion addendum and this protocol precede first prepared daily series. No model tuning/scoring has occurred.
